source.title: Ruby Pigment — original beta build 8885 40-mill stack-size report

inputName: Unknown violet-pigment-producing herb(s); individual herb IDs not specified
quote: After milling for violet pigment 40 times, 17 of those got me ruby pigment.
notes: Original author states beta build 8885: 40 finished milling casts, 17 Ruby-positive casts, 19 total Ruby Pigment, precisely ONE 3x Ruby hit. Therefore the remaining 16 positive outcomes each yielded 1 and 23 casts had no Ruby (NOT no overall pigment). Per-material 0/1/3 histogram directly reconstructed from the source's disjoint event counts. Specific input herb(s), skill, specialization, patch/hotfix date, refunds and other pigment totals unknown. Beta 8885 is historical; separate comment by same author describes materially changed beta build 8905, not merged here. Do not apply 8885 histogram to modern Retail or a named herb.
